edges.label: Chaired the NASA UAP Independent Study Team
edges.note: Commissioned 24 May 2022, one public meeting 31 May 2023, report delivered and team dissolved 14 September 2023.

edges.label: Ran concurrently with, and separately from, AARO
edges.note: Two federal UAP bodies operated in parallel through 2022-2023 with no public mechanism for the unclassified panel to see AARO's classified holdings.

edges.label: Concluded data was insufficient - having been given only the unclassified record
edges.note: Sixteen serious scientists examining only unclassified material concluded that unclassified material is insufficient. The finding measures the panel's access, not the government's holdings.
